title: Chapter 1418 - 3: The Newborn Origin World (Part 2)

Chapter 1418 - 3: The Newborn Origin World (Part 2)

Chapter 1418: Chapter 3: The Newborn Origin World (Part 2)

"Thank you."

Lin Yuan was quite grateful.

The name of the Time Lord is not something that can be mentioned casually.

Because it will truly be sensed by the master, and a response will be made.

With that promise from the twelve-eyed beast, Lin Yuan is basically out of true danger within the infinity spacetime.

As for the lords of the third tier of legend? The number of lords of this level is extremely rare. Even if they enter the infinity spacetime, they will go straight to the deepest part, and there will basically be no interaction with new lords like Lin Yuan.

...

Chaos Void.

Lin Yuan sat cross-legged, browsing the intelligence about ’infinity spacetime.’

The information provided by the twelve-eyed beast was very detailed, not only about the ’infinity spacetime’ itself but also many deeds of the Lord Wanwei.

The Lord Wanwei has not only progressed to the later stages of the ’endless tribulation’ path of transcendence but has also explored extremely ancient times on the ’infinite origin’ path of transcendence.

In addition, Lord Wanwei is the highest achiever on the ’soul perfection’ path.

Before Lord Wanwei, besides the mainstream three paths of transcendence, there were some other paths of transcendence.

One of them, named ’soul perfection,’ was recognized by quite a few lords.

Perfect soul means reaching a flawless and immaculate state in the soul, and then nurturing a perfect mind with the perfect soul, transcending through the mind.

The so-called perfect soul is to achieve an unsurpassable level in the soul, standing at an absolutely perfect height in the realm of lords.

It should be understood that the soul of life is extremely special; wanting it to be flawless is basically unachievable.

But Lord Wanwei somehow managed it, yet unfortunately, the ultimately flawless soul did not nurture a perfect mind, and even Lord Wanwei’s strength did not improve much.

It is precisely because of Lord Wanwei that the ’soul perfection’ path of transcendence was proven impossible and could not lead to a lord’s transcendence.

...

The more Lin Yuan read about Lord Wanwei, the more questions arose in his heart—

Why did Lord Wanwei choose to impact the perfect time being in the end?

Wouldn’t it be more assured to continue exploring the ’infinite origin’ path of transcendence or choose to undergo tribulations?

From a certain perspective, when Lord Wanwei chose to impact the perfect time being, it might have been better to do so when he first became a lord; after countless years as a lord, reaching limits on many paths, yet still choosing this transcendence path, which relies solely on destiny?

Wouldn’t all previous efforts be meaningless?

"Perhaps Lord Wanwei believed he couldn’t overcome the subsequent tribulations."

Lin Yuan thought to himself.

Is it only when there is no hope on the path of endless tribulation that one chooses to impact the perfect time being?

"I am fortunate."

Lin Yuan examined himself. At least with the help of the World-Breaking Origin Force, as long as he chooses ’endless tribulation,’ he is almost certain to overcome all tribulations.

It’s merely a question of World-Breaking Origin Force quantity, that is, the length of time.

"With the opening of infinity spacetime this time, I might as well go in and explore."

Having finished perusing the intelligence on ’infinity spacetime,’ Lin Yuan thought to himself.

Exploring infinity spacetime, as long as one is a bit careful, isn’t very dangerous.

Unless it’s to compete for some treasured artifact and fight with other lords.

Or delve into some perilous areas.

Some dangerous places within infinity spacetime can threaten a lord’s existence.

But as long as these are avoided, the issue isn’t very large.

...

Outside the Chaos Void.

Two figures descended.

"Brother Galaxy."

The Mother of the Screw Realm and Wan Chengkong patiently waited for a while.

Lin Yuan’s figure soon materialized.

"Brother Galaxy."

Wan Chengkong’s face broke into a smile, greeting Lin Yuan.

"Brother Galaxy."

The Mother of the Screw Realm did the same.

Since the battle of the Milky Way, the two beings of the Second Realm of time often came to find Lin Yuan to drink and strengthen their relationships.

"Not too long since we last met, it seems you have business with me." Lin Yuan smiled, happy to converse with the Mother of the Screw Realm and Wan Chengkong. After all, these two beings of the Second Realm of time were knowledgeable, and Lin Yuan could learn many interesting things from them.

"It’s something important," the Mother of the Screw Realm smiled: "Brother Galaxy, do you know... infinity spacetime?"

"Infinity spacetime?"

Lin Yuan nodded, "I know a little."

He had just purchased detailed Wanwei time-space intelligence from the owner of the Time-Space Shop.

"The opening of Wanwei time-space, Lord Chu Wei has issued a summons, wanting to bring us Second Realm beings together into Wanwei time-space." Mother of the Screw Realm spoke bluntly, "Within Wanwei time-space, there are some dangerous realms, and Lord Chu Wei needs some time beings to help explore, hence plans to hire us."

"Exploring?"

Lin Yuan understood.

Wanwei time-space harbors many dangerous realms, some of which pose threats to lords, thus time beings are needed to explore.

"How much Time Sand does Lord Chu Wei intend to give?" Lin Yuan casually asked.

"Two thousand pounds of Time Sand." Mother of the Screw Realm replied, "Additionally, if other gains are obtained within Wanwei time-space, Lord Chu Wei is willing to spent equivalent Time Sand to purchase them."

"I see."

Lin Yuan nodded slightly.

Compared to Lord Ye Wu’s requirements.

Lord Chu Wei is quite demanding.

Not only giving just two thousand pounds of Time Sand, but even compelling the handover of any gains within Wanwei time-space.

Though Lord Chu Wei promises to purchase with equivalent Time Sand, many gains within Wanwei time-space are unavailable outside.

Whereas Lord Ye Wu’s demand of Lin Yuan was merely to heed commands, and wouldn’t bother with Lin Yuan’s acquisitions.

"Lord Chu Wei’s terms are quite good."

Wan Chengkong said beside him, "Wanwei time-space may remain open for a million years, once agreed, there’s at least an income of two thousand pounds of Time Sand."

Wan Chengkong looked at Lin Yuan, "Galaxy, would you like to join us?"

"I’ll pass."

Lin Yuan shook his head.

Though he does intend to enter Wanwei time-space, he’s not planning to join other lords, let alone exploring like Mother of the Screw Realm and Wan Chengkong.

"Alright then."

Mother of the Screw Realm and Wan Chengkong did not think much, perhaps assuming Lin Yuan found Wanwei time-space too dangerous.

Indeed, Wanwei time-space poses significant dangers to Second Realm time beings, with a likelihood of encountering lord-level existences.

But danger begets opportunity.

Is it possible to earn thousands of Time Sand without danger? How could it be?

Besides, acquiring certain treasures or curiosities would far exceed mere thousands of Time Sand.

...

After chatting a while longer with the two, Mother of the Screw Realm and Wan Chengkong.

Lin Yuan watched the others gradually fade away.

"Wanwei time-space has a hundred years still before it opens."

Lin Yuan thought to himself, "During this time besides cultivation, I can explore the fourth source world."

The coordinates of thirty-three source worlds deep within the Myriad Realms Gate, Lin Yuan has successfully explored the first three.

"The fourth source world."

Lin Yuan’s consciousness sank deeply into his mind, gazing at the majestic and grand Myriad Realms Gate.

Each time he observes the Myriad Realms Gate, Lin Yuan perceives differently, the higher his realm, the more awe-inspiring it becomes.

"Let’s see this source world."

Lin Yuan gathered his thoughts, directing a strand of consciousness, using the Myriad Realms Gate as the ’mediator’, swiftly reaching the vicinity outside the fourth source world.

Each time he descends into a new world, Lin Yuan acts this way mainly to gain a rough understanding of the impending world’s information.

"Hmm?"

With the perspective of the Myriad Realms Gate, many secrets of this source world were clear to Lin Yuan.

Compared to the previous three source worlds, the fourth source world is extremely unique.

As this source world has just undergone a great cataclysm and is in the newborn phase.

During this phase, the Dao Origin within the source world fully manifests, numerous opportunities are everywhere, and simultaneously, bizarre lifeforms may be birthed.

"This..." Lin Yuan’s expression showed a hint of peculiarity.

Despite being countless years behind the strongest of a source world, Lin Yuan could quickly catch up and surpass within a short time.

Now, sharing the newborn stage of the world, all are standing at the same starting line, Lin Yuan descending at this moment, wouldn’t he easily dominate?

...

...

...
